summary: CervoMed filed an 8-K furnishing a press release with initial 12-week data from its Phase 2a trial of neflamapimod in nonfluent variant primary progressive aphasia, presented in a late-breaking oral session at ISFTD 2026; plasma neurofilament light declined on average, with greater reduction in patients at or above median baseline. 24-week biomarker data is slated for the November 2026 CTAD meeting and clinical data for Q1 2027. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, or advisor is referenced; this is a routine clinical-update disclosure, not a special situation.
